chunks: Yet the infidels persist in denial.
ai.seo_question: What is the primary spiritual state of the disbelievers according to Surah Al-Mursalat?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse highlights that the disbelievers' rejection is not merely passive ignorance but an active, stubborn denial (takdhib) of the divine truth. This condition is often contrasted with the believers' acceptance, illustrating the spiritual consequence of rejecting the Prophets and Imams who convey God's message.
